name: Try small cases first
definition: When a problem asks about a hundred of something, do two, three and four first. The small cases reveal the pattern or the reason, and they are cheap. This is the single most reliable way into a five-point problem you do not immediately see.
recognizeWhen: what happens with one hundred of them
the pattern continues for many steps
in general, how many are there
the problem uses a large number
misconceptions: I attacked the big case directly and got lost in the arithmetic.
I tried one small case, saw a pattern, and trusted it without a second case.
I chose small cases that were too special to show the general behaviour.
